original: saṃmārjanaṃ sugvat | pratitapanaṃ nyagbhūtasya tapanam | agnigrahaṇam anarthakam | anyatra pratitapanasyāsaṃbhavāt | tat kriyate darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ saṃmārjane ye dharmās teṣām iha prāptyartham āhavanīye gārhapatye vā coditaṃ yat pratitapanaṃ tad asminn agnau bhavatīti | agnimātraṃ bhidyate | anyat samānaṃ “suvam agnaiḥ” [ĀpŚr 2.4.4] ityādi | agnau praharatīti punar agnigrahaṇaṃ suksaṃmārjane dṛṣṭaṃ vaikalpikam agnau praharaṇaṃ mā bhūd iti | ato ‘pi vijñāyate suksaṃmārjanadharmā iha pravartanta iti | pākayajñeṣu ca darvyā homaḥ, kalpāntare dṛṣṭatvād darśanāc ca | yad ayaṃ samāvartane darvyām ādāyājyenābhyānayann ity anyapare vākye darvīṃ prāptāṃ darśayati | yac cāyaṃ sakṛd upahatyeti upaghātaṃ sthālīpākād darśayati tad api nādarvyām upapadyate | tatrājyahomeṣv ekā darvī | sthālīpākeṣu dve homārthaṃ cāvadānārthaṃ ca | ubhayor api saṃmārjanam | avadānasya homārthatvāt yathāgnihotre sruvasya | yatra darvīm agnau pratitapyeti vaktavyam | yena juhotīti kim ucyate | “madhyameṇāntamena vā palāśaparṇena” ity atrāpi yathā syāt, agnihotre āgnihotrike ca tantre yathā syād iti | yady evam añjaler api prasaṅgaḥ | vivāhasarpayajñādiṣu jñāpakāt siddham | yad ayam aupakārye pārvaṇavad iti yatnaṃ karoti tat jñāpayati – añjalihomā adharmagrāhakāḥ yāvaduktadharmāṇa iti | tena sādanādi trayam añjaler na bhavati || 2.1 ||

original: apara āha — nātra pārvaṇadevate anūdyete agniś ca sviṣṭakṛc ca | kiṃ tarhi | āgantuke ete anenaiva vacanena vidhīyete | tatra haviṣo ‘nupadiṣṭatvāt agner ājyaṃ haviḥ | sviṣṭakṛtas tu sarvo haviḥśeṣa iti | sarvathā sarveṣv eva pārvaṇātidiṣṭeṣv agniḥ pūrvaṃ yaṣṭavyaḥ | tathā ca śrauteṣu dṛśyate “yena yajñenertset kuryād eva tatrāgneyam” iti | yathā bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyāyate | pārvaṇavyākhyāteṣu sarveṣv eva karmasu yathopadeśaṃ devatā yajati agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ ca yajati yo ‘yam agnisviṣṭakṛt pārvaṇe dvitīyo devatāviśeṣaḥ taṃ ca yajati tasmād eva haviṣaḥ | yat tatra tatropadiṣṭānāṃ havir iti | tatra yathopadeśaṃ devatā ity anuvādaḥ sviṣṭakṛtaḥ samuccayavidhānārthaḥ | asati samuccaye teṣu tasya pravṛttir na syāt | tatra tatropadiṣṭabhir devatābhir nivartitatvāt | agner iva sviṣṭakṛto ‘pi pradhānadevatāvac coditatvāt — agnisviṣṭakṛd dvitīya iti | antareṇa ity anena tu tasyaiva sviṣṭakṛto deśo niyamyate —pradhānāhutīś copahomāṃś cāntaraṇogniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajatīti | tena yatrāpy uttarā āhutīr hutvā jayādi pratipadyate, “ājyāhutīr uttarāḥ jayādi pratipadyate” iti ca kramaparaṃ vacanaṃ tatrāpi nityam agnisviṣṭakṛd asminn antarāle yaṣṭavyo bhavatīti | prakaraṇāc ca pradhānāhutīr upahomāś cāntareṇety artho ‘pi labhyate || 7.24 ||
analyzed: aparaḥ āha na atra pārvaṇa devate anūdyete agniḥ ca sviṣṭakṛt ca kim tarhi āgantuke ete anena eva vacanena vidhīyete tatra haviṣaḥ n upadiṣṭa tvāt agneḥ ājyam haviḥ sviṣṭakṛtaḥ tu sarvaḥ haviḥ śeṣaḥ iti sarvathā sarveṣu eva pārvaṇa atidiṣṭeṣu agniḥ pūrvam yaṣṭavyaḥ tathā ca śrauteṣu dṛśyate yena yajñena īrtset kuryāt eva tatra āgneyam iti yathā bhāṣyam vyākhyāyate pārvaṇa vyākhyāteṣu sarveṣu eva karmasu yathopade

original: “āryāḥ prayatā vaiśvadeve” (ĀpDh 2.3.1) iti codite vaiśvadevākhye karmaṇi devatopadeśo ‘yaṃ nirvāpakāle saṃkalpārtham | yās tu tatra devatāḥ “ṣaḍbhir ādyaiḥ pratimantram” (ĀpDh 2.3.16) ityevamādyāḥ tāḥ pradānakāle devatāḥ, tena viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ iti saṃkalpya gṛhasthena svagṛhe pākaḥ kāryaḥ | tathā pakvād evānnāt homā balayaś ca tasyai tasyai devatāyai | “ahar ahar bhūtabalīḥ” (ĀpDh 1.12.15) ity evamādyāḥ pañcamahāyajñānām utpattividhayaḥ | “āryāḥ prayatāḥ” (ĀpDh 2.3.1) ityādikas tu teṣām eva prayogavidhiḥ | tasmāt na pṛthak pañcamahāyajñāḥ kartavyāḥ tatraiva vaiśvadevam | yad agnau kriyate sa devayajñaḥ | yat baliharaṇaṃ sa bhūtayajñaḥ | yad dakṣiṇataḥ pitṛliṅgeneti sa pitṛyajñaḥ | yad agnaṃ(?) ca deyam ity ādi sa manuṣyayajñaḥ | tatra vaiśvadeve somāya svāheti dvitīyāhutir iti mantravyākhyākāreṇoktam | na ca ṣaḍbhir ādyair iti virodhaḥ, tasya pradhānadevatāviṣayatvāt, sviṣṭakṛtaś ca tāntrikatvāt |
analyzed: āryāḥ prayatāḥ vaiśvadeve āp SPr3In iti ca udite vaiśvadeva ākhye karmaṇi devatā upadeśaḥ yam nirvāpa kāle saṃkalpa artham yāḥ tu tatra devatāḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ ādyaiḥ pratimantram āp 2316 iti evamādyāḥ tāḥ pradāna kāle devatāḥ tena viśvebhyaḥ devebhyaḥ iti saṃkalpya gṛhasthena sva gṛhe pākaḥ kāryaḥ tathā pakvāt eva annāt homāḥ balayaḥ ca tasyai tasyai devatāyai ahar ahar bhūta balīḥ āp PaCp iti evamādyāḥ pañca mahāyajñānām utpa

original: yathāha baudhāyanaḥ — “pauroḍāśikaṃ yājamānaṃ hotāro hautraṃ pitṛmedha iti sabrāhṇaṇāni sānubrāhmaṇāni prājāpatyāni | ārdhvayavaṃ grahāḥ dākṣiṇāni samiṣṭayajūṃṣy avabhṛthayajūṃṣi vājapeyaḥ śukriyāṇi savā iti sabrāhmaṇāni sānubrāhmaṇāni saumyāni | agnyādheyaṃ punarādheyam agnihotram agnupasthānam agnicayanaṃ sāvitranāciketacāturhotriyavaiśvasṛjāruṇā iti sabrāhmaṇāni sānubrāhmamāny āgyeyāni | rājasūyaḥ paśubandhaḥ iṣṭayo nakṣatreṣṭayo divaśyenayo ‘pāghāḥ satrāyaṇam upahomāḥ sūktāny upānuvākyaṃ yājyā aśvamedhaḥ puruṣamedhaḥ sautrāmaṇy acchidrāṇi paśuhautram upaniṣada iti sabrāhmaṇāni sānubrāhmaṇāni vaiśvadevāni” iti (BauGṛ 3-1.21.24) | asmākaṃ ca gṛhyamantrapraśnadvayam apy ekāgnikāṇḍaṃ nāma vaiśvadevakāṇḍe draṣṭavyam | tatra kāṇḍopākaraṇe tasya kāṇḍasya ṛṣir yaḥ tasmai homaḥ prajāpataye kāṇḍaṛṣaye svāheti |
analyzed: yathā āha baudhāyanaḥ pauroḍāśikam yājamānam hotāraḥ hautram pitṛ medhaḥ iti sabrāhṇaṇāni sa anubrāhmaṇāni prājāpatyāni ārdhvayavam grahāḥ dākṣiṇāni samiṣṭa yajūṃṣi avabhṛthayajūṃṣi vājapeyaḥ śukriyāṇi savāḥ iti sabrāhmaṇāni sa anubrāhmaṇāni saumyāni agnyādheyam punarādheyam agnihotram agnupasthānam agnicayanam sāvitra nāciketa cāturhotriya vaiśvasṛja aruṇāḥ iti sabrāhmaṇāni sa anubrāhmaṇāni āgyeyāni rājasū

original: pūrvāḥ saptājyāhutayaḥ uttarāḥ ṣaḍ annāhutaya ity arthaḥ | mantrās tu yathāmnātam eva | prayogaḥ – pūrvadyur nivedanaṃ sāyaṃ bhojanānantaraṃ śvaḥ śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyatīti | tata ārabhya vratacaryā sarveṣām | (vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ pūrvedyuḥ sāyaṃ bhojanaṃ na bhavati | “yad anāśvān upavaset pitṛdevatyaḥ syād” iti liṅgād iti) | athāparedyuḥ prātaḥ dvatīyaṃ nivedanam – adya kriyata iti | athābyaṅgas tato ‘parāhṇe snātān kṛtapacchaucān tān āmantrayate | pūrvaṃ viśvebhyo devebhyo yajñopavītī yugmān dvau caturo vā “māsi śrāddhe viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ kṣaṇaḥ kartavyaḥ” iti | “oṃ tathā” iti prativacanam | “prāpnotu bhavān” iti yathāsanaṃ prāpaṇam | “prāpnavāni” iti prativacanam | dvebhyaḥ prāṅmukhāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ prāṅmūleṣu darbheṣu | pitṛbhya udaṅmukhāḥ dviguṇabhugneṣu dakṣiṇāgreṣu yuvānaḥ pitre | vṛddhāḥ pitāmahāya | vṛddhatamāḥ prapitāmahāya | ekaikasya trayas trayo vā | śucau deśe dakṣiṇāpravaṇe śrāddhāgāraṃ sarvataḥ pariśritam udagavādvāraṃ tasya pūrvottare deśe agnir aupāsanaḥ | tasyā dakṣiṇataḥ piṇḍadānārthaṃ sthaṇḍilam | tasya dakṣiṇataḥ udaṅmukhāḥ pitrārthāḥ paścāt prāṅmukhāḥ devārthāḥ | tasminn eva sthaṇḍile yathāvakāśaṃ triṣu pātreṣu pitṛbhya udakāny arghyāṇi dakṣiṇāpavargāṇi tilavanti | devebhya ekasmin yavamati | tāni puṣpair avakīrya darbheṣu sādayitvā darbhaiḥ pracchādya āsanagatānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ hasteṣu svasmāt svasmāt udapātrāt pātrāntareṇāpa ādāya “visve devā idaṃ vo ‘rghyaṃ”, “pitaḥ idaṃ te ‘rghyam, pitāmaha idaṃ te ‘rghyam, prapitāmaha idaṃ te ‘rghyam,” ity argyāṇi dadāti tūṣṇīṃ vā | purastād upariṣṭāc ca śuddhodakam | tato gandhādibhiḥ vāsobhiś ca dvijān abhyarcya “uddhriyatām agnau ca kriyatām” ity āmantrayate | “kāmam uddhriyatāṃ kāmam agnau ca kriyatām” iti prativacanam | tato brāhmaṇārthaṃ saṃskṛtād annād uddhṛtyāpareṇāgniṃ bahirṣi pratiṣṭhāpyābhighāryāgner upasamādhānādyajyabhāgānte trayodaśa pradhānāhutīr juhoti || 21.5 ||
analyzed: pūrvāḥ sapta ājya āhutayaḥ uttarāḥ ṣaṭ anna āhutayaḥ iti arthaḥ mantrāḥ tu yathāmnātam eva prayogaḥ pūrvadyus nivedanam sāyam bhojana anantaram śvas śrāddham bhaviṣyati iti tatas ārabhya vrata caryā sarveṣām vayam tu brūmaḥ pūrvedyus sāyam bhojanam na bhavati yat anāśvān upavaset pitṛ devatyaḥ syāt iti liṅgāt iti atha aparedyus prātar dvatīyam nivedanam adya kriyate iti atha abyaṅgaḥ tatas parāhṇe snātān kṛta pad śaucān tān āmantrayate

analyzed: atha adbhuta utpāta prāyaścittam adbhutam apūrvam adṛṣṭa caram tasya adbhutasya adṛṣṭa carasya utpātaḥ upajanaḥ yat vā ūrdhva bhavāḥ adbhuta aviśeṣāḥ eva utpātāḥ divyāḥ āntarikṣyāḥ ca rātrau indradhanuḥ lohinī dyauḥ āditye kīla darśanam ityādayaḥ tasmin pakṣe dbhuta śabdena bhaumāni ucyante govalīvarda nyāyena dvandvaḥ ca samāsaḥ tatra udāharaṇa rūpeṇa kānicid adbhutāni darśayati agāra sthūṇā iti virohaṇam aṅkura upajanana

original: ity āśvalāyanaḥ | jayadivacanenaiva tantrasamuccayapratiṣedhaḥ | tad api prāyaścittaṃ vikalpena bhavati pṛthaktantra iti | tatrāpi śamyāḥ paridhyarthe | asyāpi prāyaścittasyāsminn eva śāstra upadiṣṭatvāt || 23.9 ||
analyzed: iti āśvalāyanaḥ jayadi vacanena eva tantra samuccaya pratiṣedhaḥ tat api prāyaścittam vikalpena bhavati pṛthak tantre iti tatra api śamyāḥ paridhi arthe asya api prāyaścittasya asmin eva śāstre upadiṣṭa tvāt

original: pariṣecanāntaṃ kṛtvābhimṛtebhya uttarayā dakṣiṇato ‘śmānaṃ paridhiṃ dadhāti dadhāti || 23.10 ||
analyzed: pariṣecana antam kṛtvā abhimṛtebhyaḥ uttarayā dakṣiṇatas śmānam paridhim dadhāti dadhāti

original: ata amātyānāṃ śarīrareṣaṇe ity asminn adbhute kaścid viśeṣaḥ yeṣāṃ pūrvāparā anvañcaḥ pramīyante te abhimṛtās tebhyas tadarthaṃ teṣāṃ mṛtyuśamanārtham uttaraṃ karma homam imaṃ kṛtvā pariṣecanānte ‘śmānaṃ paridhim antardhānaṃ mṛttyunivāraṇārthaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati uttarayarcā “imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ” ity etayā | abhyāsaḥ praśnasamāptidyotakaḥ | paridhim iti vacanāt tasyāśmanaḥ pracyāvanaṃ na kāryam, tatraiva pratiṣṭhito bhavati || 23.10 ||
analyzed: ata amātyānām śarīra reṣaṇe iti asmin adbhute kaścid viśeṣaḥ yeṣām pūrva aparāḥ anvañcaḥ pramīyante te abhimṛtāḥ tebhyaḥ tad artham teṣām mṛtyu śamana artham uttaram karma homam imam kṛtvā pariṣecana ante śmānam paridhim antardhānam mṛttyu nivāraṇa artham pratiṣṭhāpayati uttarayā ṛcā imam jīvebhyaḥ iti etayā abhyāsaḥ praśna samāpti dyotakaḥ paridhim iti vacanāt tasya aśmanaḥ pracyāvanam na kāryam tatra eva pratiṣṭhitaḥ bhava

original: iti śrīharadattamiśraviracitāyāṃ gṛhyavṛttāv anākulāyāṃ
